Page 1544 
Skyrizi (risankizumab-rzaa) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-684216  
Guideline Name 
Skyrizi (risankizumab-rzaa)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
9/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Skyrizi SC 55 mg*, Skyrizi SC 150 mg*  
Diagnosis 
Plaque Psoriasis (PsO)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims 
documenting ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of moderate to severe plaque psoriasis (PsO)  


--- PDF page 1545 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1545 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Greater than or equal to 3 percent body surface area involvement, palmoplantar, facial, or 
genital involvement, or severe scalp psoriasis  
 
AND 
 
 1.3 Minimum duration of a 4-week trial and failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ONE of 
the following topical therapies:  
• 
corticosteroids (e.g., betamethasone, clobetasol, desonide)  
• 
vitamin D analogs (e.g., calcitriol, calcipotriene)  
• 
tazarotene  
• 
calcineurin inhibitors (e.g., tacrolimus, pimecrolimus)  
 
AND 
 
 1.4 History of failure to a 3 month trial of methotrexate at the maximally indicated dose within 
the last 6 months, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are 
experienced  
 
AND 
 
 1.5 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ONE of the following topical 
therapies:  
• 
Vtama  
• 
Zoryve 0.3% cream  
 
AND 
 
 1.6 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the following:  
• 
A preferred^ adalimumab biosimilar or Enbrel (etanercept)  
• 
infliximab  
• 
Otezla (apremilast)  
• 
A preferred^ ustekinumab biosimilar  


--- PDF page 1546 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1546 
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is 6 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a dermatologist  
Notes  
*If patient meets criteria above, please approve at GPI-14.  
 
^PDL link: https://www.uhcprovider.com/en/health-plans-by-state/arizo
na-health-plans/az-comm-plan-home/az-cp-pharmacy.html?rfid=UHC
CP 
 
Product Name:Skyrizi SC 55 mg*, Skyrizi SC 150 mg*  
Diagnosis 
Plaque Psoriasis (PsO)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting positive clinical response 
to therapy  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a dermatologist  
Notes  
*If patient meets criteria above, please approve at GPI-14. 
 
Product Name:Skyrizi SC 55 mg*, Skyrizi SC 150 mg*  
Diagnosis 
Psoriatic Arthritis (PsA)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  


--- PDF page 1547 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1547 
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims 
documenting ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of active psoriatic arthritis (PsA)  
 
AND 
 
 1.2 History of failure to a 3 month trial of methotrexate at the maximally indicated dose within 
the last 6 months, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are 
experienced  
 
AND 
 
 1.3 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the following:  
• 
A preferred^ adalimumab biosimilar or Enbrel (etanercept)  
• 
infliximab  
• 
Orencia (abatacept)  
• 
Otezla (apremilast)  
• 
Brand Xeljanz/Brand Xeljanz XR  
• 
A preferred^ ustekinumab biosimilar  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is 6 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with ONE of the following:  
• 
Dermatologist  
• 
Rheumatologist

*If patient meets criteria above, please approve at GPI-14.

Product Name:Skyrizi SC 180 mg*, Skyrizi SC 360 mg*  
Diagnosis 
Crohn's Disease (CD)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    


--- PDF page 1549 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1549 
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims 
documenting ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of moderately to severely active Crohn's disease (CD)  
 
AND 
 
 1.2 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ONE of the following conventional 
therapies:  
• 
6-mercaptopurine  
• 
Azathioprine  
• 
Methotrexate  
• 
Corticosteroid (e.g., prednisone)  
 
AND 
 
 1.3 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the following:  
• 
A preferred^ adalimumab biosimilar  
• 
infliximab  
• 
A preferred^ ustekinumab biosimilar  
 
AND 
 
2 - Will be used as a maintenance dose following the intravenous induction doses  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a gastroenterologist  
Notes  
*If patient meets criteria above, please approve at GPI-14.  
 
^PDL link: https://www.uhcprovider.com/en/health-plans-by-state/arizo

Diagnosis 
Ulcerative Colitis (UC)

Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims 
documenting ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis (UC)  
 
AND 
 
 1.2 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ONE of the following conventional 
therapies:  
• 
6-mercaptopurine  
• 
Azathioprine  
• 
Corticosteroid (e.g., prednisone)  
• 
Aminosalicylate (e.g., mesalamine, olsalazine, sulfasalazine)  
 
AND 
 
 1.3 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the following:  
• 
A preferred^ adalimumab biosimilar  
• 
infliximab  
• 
Brand Xeljanz (IR or XR) tablet  
• 
A preferred^ ustekinumab biosimilar  
 
AND 
 
2 - Will be used as a maintenance dose following the intravenous induction doses  
 
AND

3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a gastroenterologist  
Notes  
*If patient meets criteria above, please approve at GPI-14.  
 
^PDL link: https://www.uhcprovider.com/en/health-plans-by-state/arizo
na-health-plans/az-comm-plan-home/az-cp-pharmacy.html?rfid=UHC
CP 
 
Product Name:Skyrizi SC 180 mg*, Skyrizi SC 360 mg*  
Diagnosis 
Crohn's Disease (CD), Ulcerative Colitis (UC)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting positive clinical response 
to therapy as evidenced by at least ONE of the following:  
• 
Improvement in intestinal inflammation (e.g., mucosal healing, improvement of lab 
values [platelet counts, erythrocyte sedimentation rate, C-reactive protein level]) from 
baseline  
• 
Reversal of high fecal output state  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a gastroenterologist  
Notes  
*If patient meets criteria above, please approve at GPI-14.
